title: zetta.AuditEvent
description: An immutable, append-only audit record (ENT-23 / FEAT-9): one governed action — a graph change, a deploy, a data-access decision, a compute-job lifecycle event, or an access-key issue/revoke (e.g. a burst node's identity, ARC-13). The id is the CRDT key / on-disk file name and is optional in the value shape that rides in the document; it is present in the on-disk projection (audit/<uuid>.json). This file mirrors the inline schema in src/core/audit_event.cpp — keep the two in sync.

id.description: The event's UUIDv4 — the CRDT key (audit:<uuid>) and on-disk file name.

action.description: The governed action this event records.

actor.description: Who acted — the login key id / principal, when known (empty when unattributed).

target.description: What was acted on — a graph name, a deployment id, or a 'kind:name' resource.

allowed.description: The outcome. For data_access it is the authorization decision; for state changes it is true (the action happened).

detail.description: A human-readable reason / summary, fit for display (e.g. the access decision's reason).

time.description: ISO-8601 UTC stamp of when the action was recorded.
